@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
+from rich.text import Text
+
+def test_url_tilde():
+    console = Console(force_terminal=True, width=100)
+    highlighter = ReprHighlighter()
+    text_str = " https://example.org/~user "
+    text = Text(text_str)
+    highlighter.highlight(text)
+    
+    # We can check the styles of the text object.
+    # text.style is a list of (style, length) tuples? No, it's more complex.
+    # Let's just see if any part of the text has the 'repr.url' style.
+    
+    # In rich.text.Text, we can iterate over the characters and check their style.
+    has_url_style = False
+    for char in text:
+        if "repr.url" in str(char.style):
+            has_url_style = True
+            break
+            
+    print(f"Text: {text_str!r}")
+    if not has_url_style:
+        print("FAILED: No URL style found")
+    else:
+        print("SUCCESS: Found URL style")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_url_tilde()
